correctness.rationale: The geometric Wiman A6 correspondence is justified from the 45 involution axes and 36 D10 quintuple-point stabilizers. The standalone exact checker constructs all 45 involutions and 36 Sylow-five subgroups from all 360 even permutations, independently verifies each normalizer incidence, confirms all degrees and connectedness, checks the exact Gram annihilating polynomial and trace moments, and derives the tree number 2^56*3^24*5^25. Modular Smith elimination over Z/p^E with E one above the tree's local determinant valuation produces the same elementary divisors for two different deleted vertices. The 80 Smith factors' product equals the independent matrix-tree number, and no unlisted prime can divide a determinant. The finite computations are exhaustive for the completely specified integer matrix; they do not claim to prove anything about unspecified infinite graph families.

originality.rationale: The claim is the integral critical group (all 80 reduced Laplacian Smith factors) of the specific 45-line/36-quintuple-point Levi graph. The 2014 and 2016 Wiman papers state line and point counts, distribution and A6 dihedral stabilizers, but not this SNF. Targeted mathematical-literature and published-record searches returned no same-graph invariant-factor computation. General line-graph and strongly-regular-graph critical-group theorems do not automatically cover this biregular bipartite graph. Priority risk remains for historic tables or different isomorphic graph nomenclature; a null search is not a uniqueness proof.

value.rationale: The highest-multiplicity stratum of the classical Wiman 45-line arrangement is a canonical A6-orbit, not an arbitrarily selected induced subgraph. Its 81-vertex incidence graph is a natural integral divisor-class object, and determining the full group is a complete exact invariant. The 28 nonunit Smith entries and exponent 1800 refine both classical incidence numbers and the spectrum-derived spanning-tree order; no general downstream theorem or large paper-scale result is asserted or needed.
